misprints.note: Ärbarhet; the print clearly has υ for ο.
There is a gap where the abbreviation point should be, but no point is printed.
The print has ν for γ and a circumflex without iota subscript.
The genitive ending is printed with a circumflex on the iota.

uncertain.note: The first ε is filled with ink. The reading σεμνός is certain from context.
The accent is small; it reads as smooth breathing plus acute rather than a circumflex. This fits the attested οἴνη (the ace on a die).
The mark on the article may carry an extra accent (ἥ); I kept ἡ.
